title: Provisional daily activities and mapped destinations

B.activities.seed.description: Deterministic activities stream; the existing resident cohort is read unchanged.

B.activities.location_tags.description: Positive mapping of acquired point and area tags to modelled activity purposes; each location is a proxy, not measured attraction capacity.

B.activities.poi_probability.description: Provisional mixture of mapped point opportunities and historical zone proxies. Retains demand where point coverage is incomplete.
B.activities.poi_probability.sweep_basis: Provisional broad activity model; not inferred trip diaries or fitted mode shares. Validate out-of-home demand and location coverage separately.

B.activities.distance_scale_m.description: Provisional distance decay for purpose-specific destination opportunity choice.
B.activities.distance_scale_m.sweep_basis: Provisional broad activity model; not inferred trip diaries or fitted mode shares. Validate out-of-home demand and location coverage separately.

value.shopping: Unpaid domestic services for household members
value.social: Socializing and communication, community participation and religious practice
value.leisure: Culture, leisure, mass-media and sports practices

B.activities.time_use_activities.description: State time-use benchmark rows. These broad divisions include in-home activity, and are not trip purposes measured locally.

B.activities.out_of_home_fraction.description: Assumed proportion of benchmark activity participants making an out-of-home outing. Applied to existing adults as a provisional proxy; not an observed adult trip rate.
B.activities.out_of_home_fraction.sweep_basis: Provisional broad activity model; not inferred trip diaries or fitted mode shares. Validate out-of-home demand and location coverage separately.

B.activities.out_of_home_time_fraction.description: Assumed allocation of benchmark per-participant minutes to one out-of-home episode; minutes include other activities within the source division.
B.activities.out_of_home_time_fraction.sweep_basis: Provisional broad activity model; not inferred trip diaries or fitted mode shares. Validate out-of-home demand and location coverage separately.

B.activities.optional_min_age_years.description: Independent discretionary tours are adult-only until household escort schedules are represented.

B.activities.max_optional_tours.description: Provisional limit on discretionary tours, selected without imposing any mode target.
B.activities.max_optional_tours.sweep_basis: Provisional broad activity model; not inferred trip diaries or fitted mode shares. Validate out-of-home demand and location coverage separately.

B.activities.home_break_s.description: Minimum modelled at-home interval between successive tours; departure follows actual return travel time.
B.activities.home_break_s.sweep_basis: Provisional broad activity model; not inferred trip diaries or fitted mode shares. Validate out-of-home demand and location coverage separately.

B.activities.discretionary_departure_s.description: Departure anchor for adults without a work or education tour.
B.activities.discretionary_departure_s.sweep_basis: Provisional broad activity model; not inferred trip diaries or fitted mode shares. Validate out-of-home demand and location coverage separately.

B.activities.departure_spread_s.description: Spread around the discretionary-only first-departure anchor.
B.activities.departure_spread_s.sweep_basis: Provisional broad activity model; not inferred trip diaries or fitted mode shares. Validate out-of-home demand and location coverage separately.

sweep.basis: The radius around an activity candidate within which the GHSL 100 m built-volume cells are summed as its attraction (build_activity_attraction.py). 100 m is the cell itself (a point on a cell edge reads half its block); 600 m is a walkable catchment that blurs neighbouring candidates together. Not observed: no employment-by-building register is published for the region.

B.activities.attraction_radius_m.description: Radius, in metres, of the built-volume sum that weights an activity candidate: non-residential volume (GHS_BUILT_V_NRES_E2025) for work, total volume (GHS_BUILT_V_E2025) for education, shopping, social and leisure.

sweep.basis: How a work destination is drawn among the OSM candidates inside the B-28 distance band. uniform: every candidate equally (every case before 22 September 2026 - a kiosk drew as many workers as a business park). ghsl_nres_volume: in proportion to the non-residential built volume within B.activities.attraction_radius_m (activity_location_attraction.csv, JRC GHSL R2023A epoch 2025), the observed proxy for the jobs a place holds; the optional purposes multiply their distance decay by the total built volume the same way. A band whose candidates all carry zero volume falls back to uniform and is counted.

B.activities.work_attraction.description: The representation gate for destination attraction in build_plans.py.

derived_from.identity: Sixth Economic Census 2013, Maharashtra, Table 2.9 (ec6_district_controls.csv, maharashtra_ec6_final p. 36): persons engaged in establishments without a hired worker / all persons engaged, per district (Mumbai 119,694 / 1,035,482 = 0.1156; Mumbai Suburban 307,703 / 1,670,999 = 0.1841; Thane 267,086 / 1,444,660 = 0.1849; Raigarh 78,019 / 264,044 = 0.2955). The own-account establishment is the job that sits in a home or a residential street front, which the GHSL non-residential volume does not see. Applied within B.activities.attraction_radius_m of each candidate.

B.activities.own_account_job_share.description: The share of a district's jobs that are located in proportion to TOTAL built volume (own-account work in homes and residential street fronts); the rest follow the non-residential built volume. Keyed by Census 2011 district code; a candidate takes the share of the district its coordinates fall in, else the four districts' combined 0.1750.
